name: chrome-bridge
description: Trusted-event Chrome automation bridge for the yolo-labz fleet. MV3 first-party extension loaded into a dedicated Profile-Auto Chrome instance plus a localhost relay daemon (cb CLI) that any sibling plugin (claude-mac-chrome, lcc, wa) can shell out to. Provides chrome.cookies + chrome.scripting (MAIN world) + chrome.debugger.Input.* primitives behind a single CLI surface — keeps Pedro's daily Chrome untouched, solves isTrusted=true gates on Vue/React SPAs (Upwork Algolia, Catalog typeahead) without Patchright/CDP-attach blast-radius, and keeps stealth-critical surfaces (LinkedIn primary, banking) hard-blocked at the extension boundary.
